# contrast.contrast_weights.contrast_weights { #fmrimod.contrast.contrast_weights.contrast_weights }

```python
contrast_weights(x, term=None, **kwargs)
```

Compute contrast weights for a specification.

This is a :func:`functools.singledispatch` generic function: ``x``
is intentionally ``Any`` because the dispatcher inspects its
runtime type and routes to one of several typed registrations
keyed on contrast-spec subclasses. The registered implementations
carry their own typed signatures.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                          | Description                                       | Default    |
|----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|------------|
| x        | [ContrastSpec](`fmrimod.contrast.contrast_spec.ContrastSpec`) | Contrast specification                            | _required_ |
| term     | [object](`object`)                                            | Term to compute weights for                       | `None`     |
| **kwargs | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                           | Additional arguments for specific implementations | `{}`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                     | Description                    |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
|        | [Contrast](`fmrimod.contrast.contrast_weights.Contrast`) | Computed contrast with weights |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                         | Description                                    |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
|        | [NotImplementedError](`NotImplementedError`) | If no method exists for the specification type |
